race.description: The Prince Of Merewether Conditional Hcp (Bm68)
race.comment: OLYMPIAN (5) is a lightly raced four-year-old back after a 19-week break. Form through the first part of last prep was very good, highlighted by a 0.7 length fourth in the Group 3 Carbine Club over the Randwick mile. Should be forward enough to run a big race on the back of three recent trials. Honest mare GLASTONBURY GIRL (9) has been in the money at both runs this prep, the latest over 1450m at the Illawarra Grange circuit when sent around at $1.65. Very fit and if she can slot in from a wide alley a well-deserved win looks on the cards. PUERTO BANUS (6) made it two wins from his last three runs when he charged home late to just get the prize over 1250m at this track. Has outstanding stats here and at this distance so he is a serious contender again. ELLOFADUDE (8) comfortably scored in a Taree Class 3 over 1263m recently. Fitter for two runs back from a spell so another big run is on the cards. HEY JUDE (12) made a solid return at Kembla last time and is open to improvement.
